note: What the creatures do, the routes through this place, and what a Remix may change.

encounters.name: The archive's keepers

locked: Function: Bring the heir/warden distinction almost into focus and expose Kaelra's censorship.
Core problem: Records are corrupted, deliberately altered, and accessible only during changing tides.
open: The keepers stop when the party shows a reader's token (none survive) or when they are destroyed.
The cut ledger page in the preservation vault (SL-TA-04) matches the thread-blade Kaelra carries; confronted, she offers practical help instead of an apology.
The route to the hidden isle is split across three record sections that flood in turn.

original.does: The archive's stone keeper; rises from the reading-hall floor to stop readers leaving with its records.
Carved lamp-bearers at the desks' ends that unfold and fly at readers.
The reading-room guardian, stepping out from the shelves.

difficulty.tuner_recommends: one more Gargoyle (at 8,11) (plays as moderate); not applied unless the map says so

terrain.light: Dark; moonlight in the route vault
terrain.water: sections that flood in turn with the tide
terrain.gaps: the moon lock and the section doors are 10 ft

may_change: the read-aloud and GM lines about them
must_keep: keepers that stop readers taking records
the tide's clock: the sections flood in turn
the cut ledger page and Kaelra's thread-blade
the measured difficulty (re-prove: as built it plays above high; moderate with the tuning's hit points, or the GM's target)
remix.freshness: a remix for returning players avoids Gargoyles and Animated Armor (both met before)

not_simulated: the sections flooding in turn (the GM's, as an event)

routes.when: A character makes a reader's token from the archive's own seal (the tide-mark carved on the column) before the keepers rise.
routes.success: The keepers take the party for readers: they will not attack anyone reading, only anyone leaving with a record. The party may read everything and must copy, not carry.
routes.failure: The token is wrong; the keepers rise as written.
routes.cost: Records cannot leave the archive: the party carries the route in copies and memory, and Kaelra's copy is the one the others will trust least.
routes.reveals: The archive protected the truth from being carried away and changed.
routes.canon: The core problem: records are only safe where no one can edit them.

routes.when: The party splits: some draw the keepers to the reading hall's far end while others read the sections as they drain.
routes.success: The readers recover the scriptorium's roll, the vault's ledger and the route chart within one tide while the keepers chase the others in circles.
routes.failure: A section floods before it is read: the party must wait a full tide (12 hours) for it.
routes.clue_elsewhere: Nothing in the reading hall delivers a locked clue; the three sections still do.
routes.reveals: In the vault, the cut page: the same fine cut as Kaelra's thread.
routes.canon: Exposes Kaelra's censorship in the same scene as the law's two bearers.

events.trigger: The moon lock turns as the tide falls (SL-TA-01); the archive starts to flood again from round 6 of a fight in the reading hall.

counter.how: Read fast and leave: the route vault stays dry longest. Holding the moon lock open is a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check each round.
